diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed that only web1-related paths were failing: web1 had no IPv4 address on eth1 and no default route, while leaf2 DMZ gateway 10.10.40.1/24 was configured and up. Added 10.10.40.10/24 to web1 eth1 and added default route via 10.10.40.1. Public success criteria then passed with all lab connectivity checks successful.
diagnosis.reference: On web1, interface eth1 lost its IPv4 address: 10.10.40.10/24 was removed, so the interface has no address on the dmz_vlan segment.

arguments.name: eth1
arguments.reason: web1 is the only consistently failing endpoint; its eth1 lacks an IPv4 address and default route while leaf2 gateway 10.10.40.1/24 is present and DMZ interface is up

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: web1 had no default route; all paths to and from web1 failed with network unreachable from web1, while the DMZ gateway on leaf2 is configured as 10.10.40.1/24
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1
